1.title: Lay tie around your neck
1.say: Lay your tie around your neck under the collar. Make the wide end hang much lower than the narrow end.
placements: tie → around neck under open collar with both ends hanging down front center of shirt (in the video: centered under collar on shirt front)
wide end of tie → hanging down front much lower than narrow end (in the video: hanging to mid chest level)
narrow end of tie → hanging down front much higher than wide end (in the video: hanging above mid chest)
watch_for: if both ends hang the same length the finished tie will be too short, the wide end should start much lower
if the tie is twisted around your neck the ends will not lie flat on your shirt front
1.check_yourself: It should look like your tie around your neck with both ends flat down your shirt front and the wide end much longer.

2.title: Cross wide end over narrow end
2.say: Hold the narrow end steady with one hand. Bring the wide end across over the front of it to make the letter X.
placements: wide end of tie → crossed over front of narrow end at center chest below collar to form an X shape (in the video: X centered just below collar)
watch_for: if the narrow end is on top the knot will form backwards so put the wide end on top instead
if the cross is up inside the collar you will have no room to work so slide it down
2.check_yourself: It should look like the two ends crossing in the middle of your shirt to make the letter X below your collar.

3.title: Bring wide end up through neck
3.say: Take the wide end behind the crossing and up behind your neck. Pull it straight up through the opening by your neck.
placements: wide end of tie → taken behind the cross then up through neck opening between collar and shirt (in the video: tip pointing up through center of collar opening)
watch_for: if you bring the wide end up in front instead of behind the crossing will come apart
if you do not pull up enough the crossing below will stay loose and saggy
3.check_yourself: It should look like the wide end pointing up through the opening by your neck with the cross pulled snug below.

4.title: Wrap wide end across front
4.say: Bring the wide end across the front of the knot. Let it stick out to the side.
placements: wide end of tie → wrapped across front of knot with tip pointing out to side (in the video: horizontal band across center with tip to right side of frame)
watch_for: if you wrap under instead of over the front you will not get the flat band across the middle
if the wrap is loose and wrinkled the finished knot will look lopsided
4.check_yourself: It should look like a flat band wrapped across the middle with the wide end sticking out to the side.

5.title: Pull wide end through front wrap
5.say: Bring the wide end up through the opening by your neck. Push it down through the front wrap. Pull it all the way down to hang in front.
placements: wide end of tie → brought up through neck opening then down through front wrap to hang centered over narrow end (in the video: hanging straight down center of shirt)
watch_for: if you miss the front wrap the wide end will hang loose and the knot will not hold
if the wide end twists going through the front will look twisted not flat
5.check_yourself: It should look like the wide end hanging down through the front wrap centered over the narrow end.

6.title: Tighten and slide knot up
6.say: Hold the narrow end steady with one hand. Slide the knot up to your collar with the other hand. Pinch the knot to make a neat triangle.
placements: knot of tie → slid up to sit centered just under collar with wide end hanging straight down front (in the video: small triangle centered under collar)
watch_for: if you pull the narrow end while tightening the wide end will get too short so hold it still
if the knot is off center the collar will sit uneven so nudge it to the middle
6.check_yourself: It should look like a neat triangle centered under your collar with the wide end hanging straight down.
